name: Merfolk harpoon thrower
pose: Thin adult fish torso with ONE continuous curled supporting tail, no legs. Throwing arm raised and drawn back behind the head, hand visibly grips a horizontal short barbed harpoon poised to throw toward screen right. Other hand holds two spare harpoons upright beside the body. Spearheads attach to shafts, fingers close around shafts. Sea-green skin, coral chest straps, short faction teal mantle.
